user.title: Set up Rezeptbox
user.description: No further details are needed. Import your recipes from the recipe list afterwards.

abort.already_configured: The recipe box is already set up. Add recipes with the import in the recipe list.

init.title: Recipe refresh
init.description: How often all recipes should be reloaded from their source pages.

data_description.update_interval_hours: 0 disables automatic refresh. Imported recipes stay available from the local cache.

import_recipe.name: Import a recipe
import_recipe.description: Imports one or more recipes from URLs (for example Chefkoch) and adds them to the recipe box.

url.name: Recipe URL
url.description: Full web address of the recipe page.

urls.name: Recipe URLs
urls.description: Multiple recipe URLs. A failing link does not block the others.

add_recipe.name: Create a recipe
add_recipe.description: Creates a recipe without a source page – for family recipes, cards or PDFs.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: Ingredient lines, one per entry (for example "200 g flour").

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: How many servings the recipe is written for.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Keywords for searching the recipe list.

url.name: Source URL
url.description: Optional web address the recipe can be found at.

remove_recipe.name: Remove a recipe
remove_recipe.description: Removes an imported recipe, its entities and its device from the recipe box.

url.name: Recipe URL
url.description: Source URL of the imported recipe.

refresh_recipe.name: Refresh a recipe
refresh_recipe.description: Reloads a single recipe from its source page.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add ingredients to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Adds the ingredients of the selected recipes to the shopping list and merges equal ingredients.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Target number of servings. The ingredient amounts are scaled accordingly.

exclude.name: Skip
exclude.description: Ingredient lines that should not be added (for example ones you already have).

merge.name: Merge
merge.description: Add up equal ingredients with the items already on the list.

export_recipes.name: Export recipes
export_recipes.description: Returns all recipes and the meal plan as JSON.

import_recipes.name: Import recipes (backup)
import_recipes.description: Reads recipes and the meal plan from a previous export.

recipes.name: Recipes
recipes.description: List of recipe data from the export.

plan.name: Meal plan
plan.description: Optional meal plan from the export.

plan_recipe.name: Plan a recipe
plan_recipe.description: Puts a recipe on a day of the meal plan.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day the recipe is planned for.

clear_meal_plan.name: Clear meal plan
clear_meal_plan.description: Removes one day or the whole meal plan.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to clear. Without a date the whole plan is cleared.

set_groups.name: Assign groups
set_groups.description: Sets which groups a recipe belongs to. A new group is created on its first assignment.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: All groups of the recipe. An empty list removes every assignment.

cannot_connect.message: The page could not be loaded. Check the URL and your internet connection.

invalid_url.message: This is not a valid web address.

no_recipe.message: No recipe was found on this page.

invalid_response.message: The page returned data that could not be read.

unknown.message: Unexpected error while importing the recipe.

recipe_not_found.message: This recipe is not in the recipe box.

invalid_recipe.message: A title and at least one ingredient are required.

manual_recipe.message: Own recipes without a source page cannot be refreshed.
